decision: treated checked-out ccfraft.tla and Network.tla as the only protocol semantics
why: the request makes TLA authoritative and forbids reuse from other worktrees

decision: kept the existing generic ExecutableTransitionSystem scaffold
why: it already makes Enabled and next authoritative for execution and reachability

decision: chose direct finite-state data with Fin 15 nodes, independent logs, and FIFO deduplicated channels
why: this keeps divergent uncommitted logs and every receive branch executable instead of baking safety into the representation

decision: encoded the fixed world, logs, configurations, retirement phases, and OrderedNoDup channels as executable Lean data
why: independent logs preserve the TLA conflict and rollback behavior; pair queues preserve the observable Network.tla order

decision: implemented every required action and receive branch behind Action, Enabled, and next
why: explicit ReceiveKind values preserve overlapping stale, ignored, out-of-state, ACK, and NACK choices

decision: proved initial LogInv, MoreThanOneLeaderInv, SignatureInv, and reachable MonotonicTermProp without assumptions
why: this is the first kernel-checked checkpoint before the full inductive invariant

decision: factored term preservation into the named TermDelta record and kept reachable proofs as consumers
why: later invariant components can reuse one action delta instead of reopening every receive case
